title: Genie Agents will soon be restricted to only the data sources attached to the agent
body:
In late September 2026, Genie Agents will be restricted to using only the data sources explicitly attached under the agent's **Sources**. Currently, a Genie Agent can go beyond its attached data sources if tables or Unity Catalog functions are referenced in its instructions.

See [Create and manage a Genie Agent](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up).
